title: Ade searches for funded PhDs
caption: Where do people actually FIND funded PhD positions? 🔎 Official job boards like EURAXESS, university PhD pages, FindAPhD, and professors' lab websites. Save this 📌 #phd #fullyfunded #research #studyabroad

scenes.backdrop: quiet research library with computers, journals and soft light

beats.text: Quddus, I googled fully funded PhD and got ten blogs, three scams, and one recipe for jollof.
beats.say: Kuddus, I googled fully funded P.H.D. and got ten blogs, three scams, and one recipe for jollof.

beats.text: You need to search where real positions are posted. In many countries, a PhD is advertised like a job, with a salary.
beats.say: You need to search where real positions are posted. In many countries, a P.H.D. is advertised like a job, with a salary.

beats.text: In places like Europe, many PhD positions are paid. You find them on job boards.
beats.say: In places like Europe, many P.H.D. positions are paid. You find them on job boards.

scenes.backdrop: modern study room with a laptop, a calendar and coffee

beats.text: Use words like PhD position, doctoral researcher, or PhD studentship, plus your field. And set up email alerts.
beats.say: Use words like P.H.D. position, doctoral researcher, or P.H.D. studentship, plus your field. And set up email alerts.

beats.text: Read the requirements carefully. Most want a CV, a motivation letter, and references. Apply to each one properly.
beats.say: Read the requirements carefully. Most want a C.V., a motivation letter, and references. Apply to each one properly.

beats.text: Alerts set. Funded PhD, I'm coming. Jollof recipe, saved for later!
beats.say: Alerts set. Funded P.H.D., I'm coming. Jollof recipe, saved for later!

scenes.backdrop: abstract glowing world map with flight paths, deep blue and gold, cinematic

beats.text: Save this, and comment your field so others can search together.
beats.say: Save this, and comment your field so others can search together.
